articles.title: Arbitrum’s council moved $30 million of Binance hack funds without the hacker’s key
articles.snippet: A 12-person committee briefly rewrote one of Arbitrum’s core contracts to spend from an address it held no key for, then put the code back. It’s the second time this year.

articles.title: Crypto investigators flag suspected $106M theft, $786K Solana bot drain
articles.snippet: A European entity may have lost $106 million from exchange accounts, while a wallet associated with a Solana arbitrage bot may have lost another $786,000.
